$comment: Template for .claude/settings.json (versioned), for projects that use the swarm plugin. deny rules apply to everyone; allow rules wait for each person's trust dialog. worktree.baseRef head: claude -w branches from the main checkout's current HEAD, not a remote ref that may lag. Pair with templates/claude/.gitignore (it ignores worktree.env only; .claude/worktrees/ is ignored by the root .gitignore).
_hooks: No SessionStart/Stop hooks here on purpose: the plugin runs hooks.sessionStart and hooks.stop from swarm.json (INTEGRATION.md section 3), and wiring them here too would run them twice. Without the plugin use settings.no-plugin.json instead. The PreToolUse gate warning below is sh-only (sed; no jq needed) and complements the plugin's own gate hook.
_plugin: extraKnownMarketplaces and enabledPlugins declare the plugin for the team (manual chapter 16 section 0). Remove both in a project that does not use the plugin and use settings.no-plugin.json.

hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); case "$f" in *vitest.config.*|*jest.config.*|*biome.json|*architecture.test.*|*docs.test.*|*scripts/dev/land.*|*scripts/dev/verify.*|*quality-ratchets.json|*.githooks/*|*.github/workflows/*|*swarm.json|*.claude/settings.json) echo "Warning: you are touching a quality gate ($f). Explain why in the commit; never relax it to make something pass." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
